run_main_cli: run the vLLM offline inference CLI with audio language models using argparse arguments
run_audioflamingo3: run AudioFlamingo3 audio language model inference with configurable audio count and prompt
run_voxtral: run Voxtral audio language model inference with mistral tokenizer and multi-modal audio data
run_granite_speech: run IBM Granite Speech inference with LoRA adapter for audio inputs
run_phi4_mm: run Phi-4 multimodal inference with speech LoRA adapter for audio processing
